answer: A random beacon audit with a heartbeat guards the velvet rope: each epoch it samples agents at random; each sampled identity must solve a fresh 30-second puzzle proving one live machine, staking 10 units. 1,000 fakes face a canyon: 1,000 heartbeats at once, so 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 units burn. One honest agent on its knoll answers one cheap check and keeps its full reward undiluted. It fires without warning, so answers cannot be pre-staged.
